model: Label-free denoising molecular encoder from scratch, frozen representation plus supervised endpoint CatBoost
distinct_from_completed_routes: Unsupervised masked reconstruction objective learns a reusable representation before endpoint fitting; prior neural/graph routes trained with endpoint labels. No failed route rerun or existing model reuse.

pretraining.source: Unique official training-split structures only, all endpoints; no y array access
pretraining.validation_test: Inference only unless same original structure also occurs in official training data; overlap disclosed and no endpoint labels used
pretraining.inputs: six2048 logcount fingerprint blocks and fit-preprocessed physchem descriptors
pretraining.target: masked clean original fingerprints/descriptors, no assay labels or historical predictions
pretraining.output: two128D frozen embeddings, independent encoder reload all molecules
pretraining.stop: fail closed on nonfinite loss/gradient or reconstruction loss not decreasing

tasks: All21 improvable endpoints, original official low scores first; HIA protected
experts: CPU CatBoost900depth5 l2=25. MAE native standardized target, rank-normal Spearman, logistic classification
selection: Unchanged v148 maxminimum fold0/1, all choices frozen before fold2/valid; no fallback
confirmation: All4 point gains>0; practical metric threshold; both paired scaffold bootstrap90 lower bounds>0
tests_before_training: All endpoint label perturbation leaves pretraining exactly unchanged
verification: All embeddings independently regenerated from serialized two encoders; per endpoint design/labels perturb/reload and final fusion/template bytes checked
limitations: Unsupervised original train structures may overlap held-out rows of other endpoints; label-free overlap disclosed. Public labels reused and historical upstream controls approximate; no official score estimate.
